draft_notice: Draft descriptors. PE teachers and Arnis instructors must review these before they are used for grading.
rounding_rule: Calculate the arithmetic mean and round to the nearest whole number; halves round up.

descriptor_templates.1: Needs substantial guidance with {focus}; the movement is not yet reliable or safe without support.
descriptor_templates.2: Shows {focus} inconsistently and needs reminders or corrections.
descriptor_templates.3: Shows {focus} correctly most of the time with only minor variation.
descriptor_templates.4: Shows {focus} confidently and consistently, with control and awareness.

criteria.name: Strike Angle
criteria.focus: the arm angle demonstrated in class

criteria.name: Body Alignment
criteria.focus: balanced body alignment during the technique

criteria.name: Body Stability
criteria.focus: a stable and controlled body position

criteria.name: Body Alignment
criteria.focus: alignment of the upper and lower body

criteria.name: Movement Synchronization
criteria.focus: timing between stance, footwork, and technique

criteria.name: Accuracy Integration
criteria.focus: accurate execution of the assessed technique

criteria.name: Overall Technique
criteria.focus: a controlled and safe overall technique
